Real or fake? One of these money facts is made up.

A. Coca-Cola's first glasses sold for five cents. B. Google was offered to Excite for seven hundred fifty thousand dollars. C. Someone paid ten thousand bitcoin for two pizzas. D. Walmart's first store opened in New York City.
Comment your guess before the answer. Three... two... one.
The fake one is D. Walmart's first store opened in Rogers, Arkansas, in 1962. The other three are real: Atlanta in 1886, Excite said no in 1999, and the pizzas were bought in May 2010.
